approaches.name: Recursion with memo (top-down)
approaches.intuition: `fewest(a) = 1 + min(fewest(a - c))`. Remember each answer so it is computed once.
approaches.space: O(amount) plus recursion depth (can hit the limit for large amounts)

approaches.name: Bottom-up table
approaches.intuition: Fill the table of fewest coins for every amount from 0 up to the target, using only smaller amounts already computed.
steps: For each amount try every coin
Report -1 if the target stays unreachable
pitfalls: Greedy (largest coin first) is wrong for sets like `[1, 3, 4]`.
Use a sentinel that cannot overflow when you add 1.

talkTrackMd: Name it an unbounded knapsack, show a counterexample to greedy, define the table, and state O(amount x coins). Mention the unreachable case.
